question: Why do those fixed only in ritual conduct need formal expiation?
premises: Some practitioners do not know the truth and rely only on ritual conduct.
When their minds begin to waver, doubt undermines their practice.
This wavering leads to a loss of knowledge.
inference: For those grounded only in conduct, mental doubt is dangerous, so formal supports are needed to prevent the loss of knowledge.
plain_english: Those who do not know the truth and are fixed only in ritual conduct suffer a loss of knowledge when their minds begin to waver.
